title: CDS Full Length Mock Test 04 (Hard Level)
description: Combined Defence Services Examination style full-length mock covering English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions.
instructions: There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
Choose the most appropriate option among the four given choices.
The paper covers English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge as in CDS.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part that contains an error: The battalion, together with its supporting arms, / were ordered / to hold the ridgeline / till first light.
options: The battalion, together with its supporting arms
questions.explanation: The true subject is singular 'battalion'; use 'was ordered'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Hardly the aircraft had taken off / when the tower / reported / a sudden drop in visibility.
options: Hardly the aircraft had taken off
questions.explanation: Correct inversion: 'Hardly had the aircraft taken off'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Each of the officers / who were selected / have to report / at the academy by Monday.
questions.explanation: 'Each of' takes singular verb 'has to report'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The news of the ceasefire / have been received / with cautious optimism / in the valley.
questions.explanation: 'News' is singular; use 'has been received'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He insisted that the patrol will move only after last light.
options: would move only after last light
will be moving only after last light
questions.explanation: Reported insistence takes 'would move'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: If I was the commanding officer, I would delay the advance.
options: If I were the commanding officer
If I am the commanding officer
If I had been the commanding officer
questions.explanation: Hypothetical condition requires subjunctive 'were'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The briefing was so lengthy that the cadets could not able to grasp the last points.
questions.explanation: 'Could not able' is ungrammatical; use 'could not grasp'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The convoy moved ______ the narrow defile under covering fire.
questions.explanation: Movement inside a narrow pass is expressed by 'through'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is not only a fine soldier ______ an able administrator.
questions.explanation: The correlative pair is 'not only ... but also'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of INTRANSIGENT.
questions.explanation: Intransigent means refusing to compromise.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of PERFIDIOUS.
questions.explanation: Perfidious means deceitful or treacherous.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of SPURIOUS.
questions.explanation: Spurious means false; antonym is genuine.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of OBSEQUIOUS.
questions.explanation: Obsequious means overly submissive; opposite is assertive.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To throw down the gauntlet' means:
questions.explanation: The phrase means to challenge someone.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To rest on one's oars' means:
options: To stop making effort after success
questions.explanation: It means to relax after an achievement.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'A storm in a teacup' means:
options: Great fuss over a trivial matter
questions.explanation: Disproportionate agitation over something small.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who is indifferent to pleasure and pain is called a/an:
questions.explanation: A stoic endures without showing feeling.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A speech made without preparation is:
questions.explanation: Extempore means spoken without rehearsal.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Rearrange: (P) the ridge before dawn (Q) the company was ordered (R) so that surprise could be retained (S) to occupy
questions.explanation: The company was ordered to occupy the ridge before dawn so that surprise could be retained.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct passive: 'The admiral issued the sailing orders at dusk.'
options: The sailing orders were issued by the admiral at dusk.
The sailing orders was issued at dusk by the admiral.
The sailing orders have issued by the admiral at dusk.
The sailing orders had been issuing at dusk.
questions.explanation: Simple past active becomes 'were issued'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I shall hold the post till reinforcements arrive.'
options: He said that he should hold the post till reinforcements arrive.
He said that he would hold the post till reinforcements arrived.
He said that he will hold the post till reinforcements arrived.
He said that I would hold the post till reinforcements arrive.
questions.explanation: First-person 'shall' becomes 'would'; present 'arrive' becomes 'arrived'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The treaty was signed ______ 11 November 1918 ______ Compiegne.
questions.explanation: A calendar date takes 'on'; a specific town or site takes 'at'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ Himalayas form a natural frontier along ______ northern border of India.
questions.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the'; a specific border also takes 'the'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A 'redoubt' in military usage is:
questions.explanation: A redoubt is an enclosed fieldwork.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To steal a march on' someone means:
options: To gain an advantage by acting first
questions.explanation: It means to get ahead of a rival by unexpected early action.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The remainder when 7^2026 is divided by 10 is:
questions.explanation: Units cycle of 7 is 7,9,3,1. 2026 ≡ 2 (mod 4), so remainder is 9.

questions.explanation: Odd divisors come from 3^2 × 5^1, so (2+1)(1+1)=6.

questions.explanation: Product = 12 × 336 = 4032; other number = 4032/84 = 48.
